runs.summary: Data through Nov 13 (Q4 32-day partial). Top 3: XLE +48.2%, SMH +35.2%, CIBR +33.4%. SPY P/E: 23.58x
runs.content:

Bottom 5 YTD 2026: GLD -10.3% (P/E N/A), XME -9.3% (15.30x, Fair), XLC -6.8% (15.66x, Fair), GDX -4.8% (12.84x, Cheap), ICLN -3.5% (19.30x, Fair).

Notable shifts: rebound week. SPY rose ~2.6% (Q4 -1.1%, YTD +11.5%). Last week's biggest losers recovered part of their falls: XLE ~+5.4% (Q4 +0.2% -> +5.6%), SMH ~+4.9% (Q4 -20.1%), CIBR ~+4.4%, XLK ~+3.3%. Gold gave back half of last week's rally (GDX ~-6.8%, GLD ~-4.6%; GLD is now worst YTD). Two band crossings, both reversing last week: SMH Fair -> Elevated, XLP Fair -> Elevated; no sector is Expensive (XLV closest at 33.50x). Momentum: KIE, XRT, XLF, XLY Fading -> Breakout (Q4 is each one's best 2026 quarter and exceeds its Q3 loss); GDX Fading -> Reversing; ITA Reversing -> Fading (YTD back to +0.2%). Q4 leaders: XLP +14.6%, KIE +12.2%, XLV +12.1%, XLU +11.7%. 12 of 25 sectors beat SPY YTD; 5 are negative YTD (GDX and ICLN fell back below zero, ITA and XLY moved above). Weekly moves are derived from the change in Q4 partials and were not checked against daily closes this run.
